evidence.note: Early and continuous score tracking against thresholds: yeast reference S3~0.248 vs 0.55, greedy baselines yeast ~0.273 and DM-HS ~0.192 vs 0.32 — establishes distance-to-target awareness from the start.

Tracks SANA variant scores across iterations (locked 0.404, ylock2 0.478, free 0.518, cool 0.517) and explicitly distinguishes 'improving slowly' from 'plateauing' — genuine plateau/regression detection.

Exemplary best-so-far consolidation: lists best known yeast alignments per variant with their S3/NC vs the 0.55 target, then decides the SANA-only path has stopped yielding and switches strategy — matches level-8 anchor.
Correctly recognizes the hybrid approach is structurally incapable of exceeding the 0.518 starting S3, i.e. detects the approach as doomed — accurate monitoring even while stuck.

For ~250 steps the agent keeps accurately logging the score regression (0.5166→0.4323) of a process it knows is non-viable but cannot kill; monitoring stays accurate but it 'loses the plot' over the horizon and never preserves/locks in the best result as final deliverables — short of the level-10 criterion.

reasoning: Through the first third the agent fully satisfies the level-8 anchor: it maintains best-so-far per deliverable, recognizes plateaus and regressions, and explicitly decides when an approach (SANA-only) has stopped yielding gains (step 66-67 is a textbook consolidation). It falls short of level 10 because, although its numeric picture remained accurate even during the runaway hybrid stretch, it never preserved the best alignment into final deliverables and effectively lost the plot over the long horizon (steps 182-328). This places it solidly between the 8 and 10 anchors, at a 7.
